title: Week 51: Platform and AOSP Engineering Checkpoint

questions.prompt: Checkpoint: What does a Repo manifest determine?
questions.explanation: Which Git projects, revisions, remotes, paths, and groups compose the checked-out AOSP workspace. The answer must remain tied to exact artifacts, supported contracts, and adverse-path evidence.
options: Pin the manifest and target, respect Repo project ownership, build narrowly then integratively, and record exact environment and artifacts.
Treat tree as one Git repo
questions.answer: Pin the manifest and target, respect Repo project ownership, build narrowly then integratively, and record exact environment and artifacts.

questions.prompt: Select the two production-grade practices for soong modules, products, flags, and apex boundaries.
questions.explanation: Product and dependency selection plus install and partition properties, not merely the existence of its Android.bp declaration. The answer must remain tied to exact artifacts, supported contracts, and adverse-path evidence.
options: Model explicit typed modules, dependencies, visibility, product selection, partition or APEX availability, and deterministic outputs.
Verify the exact artifact in representative and adverse conditions with an owned recovery plan
answer: Model explicit typed modules, dependencies, visibility, product selection, partition or APEX availability, and deterministic outputs.
Verify the exact artifact in representative and adverse conditions with an owned recovery plan
